newsitem.title: USA: All American Q3 syndicated TV revs fall.
newsitem.headline: All American Q3 syndicated TV revs fall.

text.p: All American Communications Inc said on Wednesday its third quarter revenues fell from the year ago period because of a decline in television syndication sales.

Third quarter revenues fell to $66.6 million from $85.2 million one year ago. The company focused primarily on its show, Baywatch, which had higher sales one year ago. Excluding Baywatch, television revenues rose by $3.8 million.
Net income at the TV show and music distributor rose to $6.1 million, or $0.42 per diluted share, versus $5.6 million, or $0.51 per diluted share.
Earnings were calculated on a higher number of shares in the third quarter, 15.4 million, as compared to the year ago quarter where 11.8 million diluted shares were outstanding.

In a statement, the company also noted its balance sheet restructuring has been substantially completed by issuing $100 million in public debt, boosting its credit line to $155 million and redeeming an issue of convertible debt.
Lastly, since October 1, All American has purchased 500,000 shares of its Class B common stock via a previously announced stock repurchase program.
